title: Neutron
extract: A neutron is a subatomic particle, symbol n or n0, that has no electric charge, and a mass slightly greater than that of a proton. The neutron was discovered by James Chadwick in 1932, leading to the discovery of nuclear fission in 1938, the first self-sustaining nuclear reactor, and the first nuclear weapon.

title: Neutron Stars Hint at Another Dimension
Neutron stars may be bigger than expected, measurement of lead nucleus suggests
